Chapter 431: Chapter 7: Grasping The Taiyang Rule (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 431: Chapter 7: Grasping the Taiyang Rule (Subscription Requested)

The Galaxy Master relentlessly persecuted special life groups, as well as Alien Lone Walkers, and the situation continued to ferment.

Even though it was speculated that the targets of the Galaxy Master’s persecution were those who had caused severe damage to the environment within the Star Domain, or those who enjoyed consuming the soul and flesh of living beings…

It still caused panic among the remaining special life groups, as well as the Alien Lone Walkers.

“The Galaxy Master is too overbearing,”

“Back then, the Chikun Star Lord was the same, showing no mercy towards us special lives…”

“The Galaxy Master is establishing his power, without these ruthless methods, how can he fully take control of this Star Domain in the future?”

...

Outside the Floral Deity Race, various special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers discussed.

These special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers,

although without the ‘Virtual World’ of human civilization capable of real-time communication without delay,

also had their own means of communication, which could enable basic communication within a Star Domain.

“What shall we do now?”

“What can we do? Surrender, of course. Do we dare to oppose the Human Civilization Alliance?”

“Gentlemen, don’t be hasty, the Galaxy Master’s cleansing method indicates he intends to fully control this Star Domain. We, the Different Species, can only choose to submit, but Lord Beifeng… surely won’t submit so easily,”

a powerful special life form said.

“Lord Beifeng.”

The rest of the special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers fell silent at the mention of his name.

As a territory once ruled by the Shadow Tribe, the Milky Way Star Region had many special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers as permanent residents.

Among these special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers, there were no lack of Eighth Rank powerhouses, and Lord Beifeng was undoubtedly the strongest.

He was the indisputable Peak Powerhouse of the Eighth Layer.

Lord Beifeng came from the Golden Lion Clan,

a powerful group within the universe.

Lord Beifeng traveled the universe and came to this Star Domain to prepare for his breakthrough to the Ninth Rank.

An Eighth Rank powerhouse does not necessarily need to master a type of cosmic force to become invincible and then break through to the Ninth Rank.

As long as one reaches the peak pinnacle of the Eighth Layer, there is hope to merge with the Fusion Rules and then assault the Ninth Rank.

Lord Beifeng was at the peak pinnacle of the Eighth Layer.

However, at Lord Beifeng’s level, external forces could hardly help him make that step.

As a result, Lord Beifeng spent most of his time in retreat, indifferent to the affairs of the outside world.

He belonged to the second category of special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers defined by Lin Yuan.

“Lord Beifeng is very powerful, surely that Galaxy Master wouldn’t dare to impose on him?”

“Very powerful? Is he as strong as the Chikun Star Lord? As strong as the Human Civilization?”

“Regardless, this matter between the Galaxy Master and Lord Beifeng is their own, we can only go with the flow…”

Many special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers discussed a great deal, but ultimately, they dispersed.

Whatever the outcome of the ‘negotiations’ between the Galaxy Master and Lord Beifeng, it was irrelevant to them; this Star Domain was destined to be ruled by the Galaxy Master.

…

“Who would have thought that even hiding here, I cannot meditate in peace?” a burly elder with golden hair said, sitting cross-legged in the void. His aura merged with the starry sky, vast and expansive, spreading out for tens of millions of miles in every direction.

“A once-in-a-lifetime human genius, entering the Eighth Layer before the age of one hundred, and now even possessing combat power of the Eighth Layer’s peak?”

This golden-haired burly elder was none other than Lord Beifeng, the peak powerhouse of the Eighth Layer.

“Better not to provoke any trouble, better to find another place,”

the golden-haired burly elder sighed, stood up, took a step, and with a ripple of spatial fluctuation, his figure appeared tens of millions of miles away.

The Golden Lion Clan, although not part of the Human Civilization Alliance, bore no significant grudge against human civilization; there was no need for Beifeng to have any interaction with the Galaxy Master.

…

The retreat of Lord Beifeng, the strongest in this Star Domain, truly shocked the special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers.

They had originally thought that with Lord Beifeng’s strength, even if he dared not confront the Galaxy Master directly, he would at least negotiate to secure some benefits before leaving.

Instead, he had not even thought twice before evacuating this Star Domain.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

“The Golden Lion Clan, Beifeng?”

Lin Yuan also learned right away of the news that an Eighth Rank peak powerhouse of a Different Species had voluntarily left.

“Quite cautious,”

Lin Yuan smiled faintly, knowing that even though Lord Beifeng was powerful, he was mostly in retreat and did not significantly impact the outside world.

Lin Yuan hadn’t planned to act against him, but the latter’s cooperation made him feel quite pleased.

“Now the entire Milky Way Star Region has basically been cleared, there’s no need for me to concern myself further,”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

As the master of the Milky Way Star Region, Lin Yuan’s greatest role was deterrence, presiding over the main star and intimidating all corners of the region.

As for managing the main star… developing the Star Domain… naturally, these were not tasks for the Star Lord, but for his subordinates to handle.

The Chikun Star Lord spent most of his time either in retreat or sleeping, and the Chikun Star Domain was just fine, overseen by three goddesses, with no major issues likely to arise.

The two Eighth Rank Alien Races given to Lin Yuan by the Chikun Star Lord were there to manage the main star and the Star Domain.

“Continue my practice and pursue Enlightenment.”

Lin Yuan closed his eyes, whether on the Chikun Main Star or now on the Milky Way Main Star, there wasn’t much difference for him; most of his time was spent on cultivation.

…

In another palace,

Hongpi, Bieyan, as well as Chun Bo and Jia Li, the four were gathered together.

“Those Different Species, they’re just too obedient. We tell them to come, and they come without even proposing any conditions?”

Jia Li looked at the replies from the Different Species, his tone inevitably astonished.
